source: NightLight.gg community stats (crowd-sourced match uploads), 28-day window 23 Jul – 20 Aug 2026, 13,645 games. Confidence: community-sourced.

items.name: The Slasher
items.power: Near-invulnerable, supernaturally strong pursuit (Jason Voorhees).

items.name: The Ghoul
items.power: Extends predatory limbs to attack and traverse terrain rapidly.

items.name: The Mastermind
items.power: Viral tendrils and bioweapon abilities.

items.name: The Animatronic
items.power: Shifts between animatronic forms with distinct attacks.

items.name: The Hillbilly
items.power: Chainsaw sprint attack that instantly downs on hit.

items.name: The Legion
items.power: Frenzy mode: fast vaults and chain-injures multiple survivors.

items.name: The Nurse
items.power: Blinks through space to reach survivors behind obstacles.

items.name: The Huntress
items.power: Throws hatchets that down survivors from range.

items.name: The Spirit
items.power: Phases into a spirit realm to move unseen and track survivors.

items.name: The Blight
items.power: Rushes forward with escalating speed, bouncing off obstacles.

items.name: The Nemesis
items.power: Tentacle strikes that can infect survivors with a virus.

items.name: The Wraith
items.power: Rings a bell to turn invisible and move faster.

items.name: The Cannibal
items.power: Chainsaw sweep that can hit multiple survivors and break obstacles.

items.name: The Shape
items.power: Stalks survivors to build Evil Within, increasing power and speed.

items.name: The Deathslinger
items.power: Fires a harpoon that hooks and reels in a survivor.

items.name: The Ghost Face
items.power: Stalks from cover while undetectable.

items.name: The Trapper
items.power: Sets bear traps to injure and immobilize survivors.

items.name: The Dark Lord
items.power: Vampiric Castlevania crossover killer — bat dash and gargoyle transformation.

items.name: The First
items.power: Warps reality through an otherworldly dimension to hunt survivors.

items.name: The Oni
items.power: Collects blood to transform into a faster, harder-hitting demon form.

items.name: The Pig
items.power: Places head traps that kill unless the right generator is completed.

items.name: The Knight
items.power: Commands spectral guards to patrol and attack automatically.

items.name: The Trickster
items.power: Throws blades in rapid succession to injure survivors.

items.name: The Doctor
items.power: Shocks survivors to reveal locations and cause madness.

items.name: The Good Guy
items.power: Shrinks down to move fast and unseen, then reverts to attack.

items.name: The Unknown
items.power: Reality-warping illusions that confuse survivor perception.

items.name: The Clown
items.power: Throws gas bottles that slow and disorient survivors.

items.name: The Nightmare
items.power: Drags sleeping survivors into the dream world.

items.name: The Onryō
items.power: Spreads cursed tapes to manifest and terrify survivors.

items.name: The Lich
items.power: Channels dark magic spell zones (Vecna, Dungeons & Dragons crossover).

items.name: The Plague
items.power: Vomits corruption onto survivors and generators.

items.name: The Executioner
items.power: Creates torment cages that punish survivors who can't escape in time.

items.name: The Dredge
items.power: Teleports between lockers and through darkness.

items.name: The Artist
items.power: Summons ravens that reveal and attack survivors.

items.name: The Xenomorph
items.power: Ambushes from tunnels with a tail-strike attack.

items.name: The Singularity
items.power: Deploys remote camera drones to teleport and attack from range.

items.name: The Demogorgon
items.power: Opens portals between map locations to ambush survivors.

items.name: The Houndmaster
items.power: Commands a spectral hound to track and assault alongside her.

items.name: The Krasue
items.power: Detaches her head to float independently and scout survivors.

items.name: The Cenobite
items.power: Summons chain-bound pain servants to chase and box survivors in.

items.name: The Hag
items.power: Plants invisible traps that teleport her to their location when triggered.

items.name: Skull Merchant
items.power: Deploys tracking drones that scan and mark nearby survivors.

items.name: The Twins
items.power: Controls a small creature to attack while the main body pursues elsewhere.

items.name: The Judgment
items.power: Observes and punishes survivors with divine authority.
